description: Looks up a German company by its name or by an identifier and returns its profile and its company_number_norm, the key the other company tools take. Intended for requests where the user names a company ('Hornbach Baumarkt AG', optionally with the city in `ort`) or gives a register number with court ('HRB 12345 Hamburg', 'Amtsgericht Köln HRB 5604'), an EUID ('DEK1101R.HRB52093'), an LEI (20 characters), a German VAT ID ('DE117663151') or a MaStR actor ID ('ABR912345678901') and wants to know which company it is. Names match on the registered name; a name with its legal form (AG, GmbH, SE, KG …) is matched as given, a name without it is also tried with the common legal forms. When one company matches, the profile and ready follow-up calls are returned (by name: other close matches in `weitere_treffer`); when several match (status 'conflict' or 'candidates'), all candidates are listed with name, city and register status and none is picked. Limits: sole proprietorships (e.K.) are not found by name; a register number without the court (e.g. a bare 'HRB 12345') cannot be resolved. Example questions (German users): 'Gibt es die Hornbach Baumarkt AG noch?', 'Wer steckt hinter DEK1101R.HRB52093?', 'Finde die Firma mit USt-IdNr. DE117663151.'

art.description: Kennungsart — optional, wird automatisch erkannt wenn weggelassen. Angeben, wenn die automatische Erkennung nicht greift.

kennung.description: Freie Eingabe: Firmenname ('Hornbach Baumarkt AG'), Registernummer mit Gericht ('HRB 12345 Hamburg', 'Amtsgericht Köln HRB 5604'), EUID ('DEK1101R.HRB52093'), LEI (20-stelliger ISO-17442-Code), USt-IdNr. ('DE117663151') oder MaStR-Akteur ('ABR912345678901').

ort.description: Optional bei Namenssuche: Ort oder PLZ des Firmensitzes, grenzt gleichnamige Firmen ein ('München').

name: find_company
title: Firma finden (Name oder Kennung)
